name: 职场工作
desc: 面试、报到入职、开会、请假、协作沟通的常用句
descEn: Common phrases for interviews, onboarding, meetings, leave requests and teamwork
author: ZiTan 社区 / ZiTan Community

deaf.t: 您好，我是听障人士，请打字或者看手机
deaf.en: Hi, I'm deaf — please type or look at my phone

deaf.t: 请把要说的话打给我看
deaf.en: Please type what you want to say

deaf.t: 我可以胜任这份工作，请放心
deaf.en: I can do this job well, rest assured

deaf.t: 请问上班时间和休息日怎么安排
deaf.en: What are the working hours and days off?

deaf.t: 请问这个任务什么时候要完成
我没听清，请再说一遍或者打出来
deaf.en: I didn't catch that — please repeat or type it

deaf.t: 请把会议重点发文字给我
deaf.en: Please send me the meeting notes in text
May I take a day off?

deaf.t: 这个报表怎么做，请指给我看
deaf.en: How do I make this report? Please show me

deaf.t: 我用文字和你交流，可以吗
deaf.en: Is it OK if we communicate in writing?

vol.t: 这个岗位工作时间是朝九晚六

vol.en: The task is due next Friday

vol.t: 会议纪要稍后发你文字版
vol.en: Meeting notes will be sent to you later

vol.t: 请假需要提前一天提交
vol.en: Leave requests should be submitted one day ahead
Ask me anytime if you need help
